::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Microsoft's SCHIE (Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering) team in India contributes to custom silicon for Azure, including work related to the Maia AI accelerator and Cobalt Arm-based CPU programmes.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Silicon engineering for Azure custom chips, including design verification, physical design, and firmware for cloud infrastructure processors.
